history.summary: IDENTITY PROVISIONAL: CSV row 2337b ('Kali Temple', Begusarai) carries no address or distinguishing detail, and Begusarai has several Kali shrines - the Kali Asthan temple on Hemra Road (Matihani Road), the Kali Mandir at Kali Asthan Chowk described by a local vlogger as 'the most famous temple of Begusarai' (the chowk is named after it), Maa Kali Mandir at Nirala Nagar, and Kali Mandirs at Malpur/Godhna. No source describes one 'Kali Temple' that can be matched to this row with certainty, so this is documented as a thin placeholder keyed to the best geocoded match (Kali Asthan, Hemra Road; FULL_ADDRESS geocoder match, coordinates used). The antiquity and history of these local shrines are not documented in published sources (verify). CSV ERROR FLAG: the CSV 'state' column held the town name (Begusarai); the real state is Bihar. town_description: Begusarai is a city and district headquarters in north-central Bihar, on the northern side of the Ganges basin, often called Bihar's 'industrial capital' for the nearby Barauni refinery, thermal power plant and fertilizer complex. It is a busy commercial town on NH-31 with a large local devotee base supporting many neighbourhood temples.
